brand_profile.name: GreenLeaf Coffee Roasters
brand_profile.about: Small-batch specialty coffee roastery and cafe in Visakhapatnam. Beans from small farms in the Araku Valley and Coorg.
brand_profile.audience: Young professionals and students aged 20-35, home-brewing beginners, gift buyers
brand_profile.voice: Warm, friendly and a little playful. Simple everyday words, short sentences, no jargon. Emojis sparingly.
brand_profile.avoid: cheap, best in the world, guaranteed
